casestudies.title: Next-Generation Satellite Communications Ground Station
casestudies.subtitle: Upgrading ISRO's Global Satellite Network Capability
casestudies.scope: Design and supply of RF amplifier subsystem for satellite communications uplinks across ISRO's global network of ground stations

challenge.overview: ISRO operates satellite communications ground stations across multiple continents requiring high-performance RF amplifiers for reliable uplink communication with active satellites.
requirements: Uplink frequency range: 8 GHz to 32 GHz with rapid frequency switching
Linearity performance: ±1 dB gain flatness across 2 GHz bandwidth
Integration with existing equipment manufactured before 2000
Extreme environmental tolerance: 0°C to 50°C, high altitude, sea-level humidity
constraints: Limited physical space in existing ground station racks
Complex integration with legacy systems requiring extensive backward compatibility
Critical mission timeline with no room for deployment delays
Need for redundant systems with automatic failover

solution.overview: Telogica designed a modular RF subsystem architecture enabling rapid deployment while maintaining full integration compatibility.
approach: Modular subsystem design allowing staged deployment across 12 ground stations
Custom impedance matching for seamless integration with legacy antenna systems
Redundant amplifier configuration with automatic failover (zero switching time)
Comprehensive environmental hardening for global deployment
Full backward compatibility through extensive system characterization
technology: Custom RF amplifiers: 50W to 500W across frequency bands
Hybrid coupler design for power combining and redundancy
Proprietary gain control with ±0.5 dB accuracy across frequency
Thermal management system maintaining <10°C temperature differential

performance.impact: Zero unplanned outages across all ground stations
12 ground stations deployed within project timeline
Highest reliability in ISRO's satellite network

business: Enabled India's next-generation satellite communication capability
Supported ISRO's expansion of satellite-based services across South Asia
Reduced dependency on imported RF equipment for critical space missions
Established Telogica as strategic partner for ISRO's space program

testimonial.quote: Telogica's RF subsystem has become the backbone of our next-generation satellite communication infrastructure. Their commitment to quality, reliability, and innovation has been instrumental in supporting India's space ambitions.
testimonial.author: Dr. K. Sivan
testimonial.title: Former Director, Indian Space Research Organisation

metrics.timeline: 18 months from design to full deployment
metrics.systems: 12 ground stations across India, Singapore, Australia, South Africa

casestudies.impact: Strategic advancement of India's space communications capability with technology that will support satellite operations for the next 20 years

casestudies.title: Rapid FTTH Deployment Across Urban India
casestudies.subtitle: Delivering Last-Mile Broadband to 500,000+ Homes
casestudies.scope: Supply of fusion splicers, cable locators, and test equipment for FTTH deployment across 12 metropolitan areas

challenge.overview: Bharti Airtel launched an aggressive FTTH (Fiber To The Home) expansion targeting 500,000 connections across India's tier-1 and tier-2 cities within 20 months.
requirements: Rapid fiber splicing: <3 minutes per joint without sacrificing quality
Field deployment across diverse urban terrain (underground, aerial, conduit)
Training 500+ field technicians to achieve consistent high-quality splices
Ruggedized equipment for monsoon and extreme heat environments
constraints: Aggressive deployment timeline: 500,000 connections in 20 months
Limited availability of trained telecom field technicians
Variable site conditions across different cities and neighborhoods
Need for consistent quality to minimize maintenance callbacks

solution.overview: Telogica provided an integrated toolkit combining advanced fusion splicers, diagnostic equipment, and comprehensive field training program.
approach: Supply of 600+ arc-fusion splicers optimized for rapid deployment
Integrated cable locators with real-time fault detection
Site analyzers for field quality verification
Real-time field support hotline and on-site technical assistance
technology: Advanced arc-fusion splicer: 45-second splice time with 0.02 dB typical loss
Lightweight, splash-proof design for field deployment
Mobile app integration for technician tracking and quality monitoring

performance.impact: Reduced per-home installation time from 6 hours to 2 hours
Minimal rework, 50% reduction in maintenance callbacks
Achieved Airtel's 'gold standard' for fiber quality
Field technicians completed 40% more installations per day

business: Enabled Airtel to capture 35% market share in FTTH segment
Reduced per-connection cost by ₹2,500 through improved efficiency
Generated 50,000+ direct and indirect jobs in fiber installation
Accelerated broadband penetration across urban India by 18 months

testimonial.quote: Telogica's fusion splicers and field support were critical to our FTTH expansion success. Their equipment reliability and technical team's responsiveness enabled us to scale operations faster than any competitor.
testimonial.author: Rajesh Patel
testimonial.title: VP Network Infrastructure, Bharti Airtel

casestudies.impact: Accelerated broadband transformation of urban India, connecting 500,000+ homes to high-speed fiber internet and enabling digital inclusion at scale

casestudies.title: Defense Fighter Radar System Integration
casestudies.subtitle: Supporting India's Advanced Combat Aircraft Platform
casestudies.scope: Design, development, and supply of RF power amplifier subsystem for next-generation fighter aircraft radar

challenge.overview: HAL's advanced fighter aircraft platform required custom RF amplifier subsystems meeting the most stringent defense specifications for radar applications.
requirements: Multi-band RF amplifiers: L, S, C, X, Ku bands with seamless band switching
Peak power output: 2-5 KW per band with ≤3 dB variation across frequency
Exceptional reliability: MTBF >5000 hours for combat aircraft operations
Environmental hardening: -40°C to +85°C, 30G vibration tolerance, high-altitude operation
Size/weight optimization: <10 kg per band channel
Integration with aircraft power management and thermal systems
constraints: Most stringent defense specifications including MIL-STD testing
Complex integration with existing radar architecture
Classified program with restricted information sharing
Zero tolerance for component failures in combat scenarios
Limited production quantities but need for long-term production support

solution.overview: Telogica designed a highly integrated, modular RF subsystem specifically architected for advanced fighter radar platforms.
approach: Modular design allowing independent band operation and graceful degradation
Custom component selection and integration optimized for aerospace reliability
Rigorous MIL-STD testing including vibration, thermal cycling, and EMI hardening
Thermal management system enabling operation in aircraft cabin conditions
Advanced diagnostics for in-flight monitoring and maintenance prediction
technology: Solid-state RF power amplifiers across L through Ku bands
Advanced GaAs and GaN semiconductor technology for efficiency
Integrated power conditioning and thermal management
Redundant components for critical amplifier stages

performance.impact: Reduced aircraft power consumption and extended mission endurance
Improved detection capability against small targets
Reduced aircraft integration cost and schedule
Zero in-service failures across aircraft fleet

military: Enabled advanced radar capabilities for next-generation fighter aircraft
Reduced dependency on imported defense RF components
Established India's capability in advanced military RF systems
Enhanced combat aircraft effectiveness and operational superiority

testimonial.quote: Telogica's RF subsystem represents a significant advancement in our combat aircraft platform. Their engineering excellence and commitment to defense specifications have been exemplary.
testimonial.author: Air Marshal R. S. Bhatia
testimonial.title: Former Air Officer-in-Charge, Air Force HQ

metrics.timeline: 24 months from design to initial deployment

casestudies.impact: Enabled India's indigenous advanced fighter radar capability, reducing defense imports and enhancing air force operational effectiveness
